group.title: Library open day
group.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Riverside Library open day, Saturday
10:00–12:00: Book swap in the lobby. Bring up to five books in good condition. No reservation is needed.
10:30–12:00: Storytelling workshop in Room A. Registration is required, and participants must attend the full session.
14:00–15:00: Introduction to the digital library in Room B. Bring a phone or tablet.
All activities are free. The café offers drinks for purchase.

DOCUMENT 2 — Email from Alex
I can visit between 11 a.m. and noon on Saturday. I have four novels I no longer need, all in excellent condition. I would like to exchange them and also learn to borrow e-books, but I cannot stay into the afternoon. Is there another way to learn the digital service?

DOCUMENT 3 — Library reply
You are welcome to join the morning swap. For e-books, our website has a step-by-step video showing the same basic process as the afternoon introduction. You will need your library card number to sign in.
group.passageZh:
文件一——Riverside 圖書館星期六開放日
10:00–12:00：大廳交換書籍。可帶最多五本狀況良好的書，不需預約。
10:30–12:00：A 教室說故事工作坊。須事先報名，參加者必須全程出席。
14:00–15:00：B 教室數位圖書館入門。請帶手機或平板。
所有活動免費，咖啡廳飲料另行付費。

文件二——Alex 的電子郵件
我星期六只能在上午十一點至中午來訪。我有四本不再需要的小說，狀況都很好。我想交換書，也想學習借電子書，但無法留到下午。有沒有其他方式學習數位服務？

文件三——圖書館回覆
歡迎你參加上午的換書活動。電子書方面，網站有逐步教學影片，示範與下午入門課相同的基本操作。登入需要你的借書證號碼。
